png.notes: First image type to pass. Correct API usage: PngOptions, new Png().Process(options), output.png

jpeg.error: System.IO.IOException: Cannot create 'output.pdf' because a file or directory with the same name already exists.
jpeg.root_cause: LLM used output.pdf extension instead of output.jpg. The Jpeg plugin (internally PdfToImage) attempts to create a directory at the output path for page images — conflicting with existing output.pdf file.
jpeg.fix_needed: Add REQUIRED constraint specifying 'output.jpg' filename explicitly, or FORBIDDEN: AddOutput with .pdf extension for Jpeg type
jpeg.sprint10_action: Add per_type_constraints Jpeg.required: 'REQUIRED: AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.jpg")) — extension must be .jpg not .pdf'

tiff.error: System.InvalidOperationException: Output TIFF was not created.
tiff.root_cause: LLM used .tif extension instead of .tiff. File.Exists('output.tif') returned false because plugin creates 'output.tiff'. The constraint specified 'output.tiff' but LLM truncated to '.tif'.
tiff.fix_needed: Add REQUIRED constraint explicitly specifying 'output.tiff' (not '.tif') filename
tiff.sprint10_action: Add per_type_constraints Tiff.required: 'REQUIRED: AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.tiff")) — extension must be .tiff not .tif'

lane3_verdict: PARTIAL_WAVE_SUCCESS — Png PASSED (first image type). Jpeg/Tiff failed due to wrong output file extensions in LLM-generated code. Root causes diagnosed. Sprint 10 constraint fixes identified.
